morphology.pattern_note: 依输入暂作不可分析形式保留；这不证明它是标准马来语词根。若为人名，应写作 Katia，读音随姓名所属语言及本人用法而定。

senses.zh_definition: 若原文指人名 Katia，可音译为“卡蒂娅”；现有材料不足以确认小写 katia 的标准马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: Provisionally, the feminine given name Katia; no standard Malay common-word meaning is established by the supplied evidence.
senses.ms_definition: Jika merujuk kepada seseorang, Katia ialah nama khas perempuan; makna kata umum bahasa Melayu baku bagi bentuk katia belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: 这是条件性的专名解释，不是 DBP 官方释义，因此状态保留为 unverified。以下搭配与例句仅示范人名用法，不声称是高频固定搭配。另有班查语词典记录 katia 为“但是”，不能据此直接认定它是标准马来语连接词。[班查语词典](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/35353/1/Kamus%20Bahasa%20Banjar-Indonesia%20untuk%20Pelajar.pdf)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场通知；假设 Katia 为人名
dual_scenarios.ms: Cik Katia akan membentangkan laporan tersebut dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 卡蒂娅小姐将在明天的会议上汇报该报告。
dual_scenarios.en: Ms Katia will present the report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友确认同行者；假设 Katia 为人名
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Katia dah sampai kat kafe ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Katia sudah tiba di kafe?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Katia arrived at the café yet?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语形式。
kat 表示地点，相当于 di。
句末 ke 标记口语疑问。

messages.ms_spoken: Katia dah sampai kat kafe ke?

messages.en: Has Katia arrived at the café yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tunggu kat dalam. Jom masuk.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba dan sedang menunggu di dalam. Mari kita masuk.
messages.zh: 到了，她在里面等着。走，进去吧。
messages.en: Yes, she's waiting inside. Let's go in.

etymology.historical_story: As a personal name, Katia crosses several European naming traditions. It is used in Italian and French and also represents a transcription of Slavic Katya. Its pronunciation therefore varies across languages. This naming history supports a possible proper-name interpretation, but it does not establish the origin or meaning of an unidentified lowercase token in a Malay corpus. [Name reference](https://www.behindthename.com/name/katia)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若确认是人名，就用“卡蒂娅 ↔ Katia”联记；不要为未知词形编造普通词义。
